capabilities: Export rendered Markdown tables and Bases views as PNG
Export table and Bases Table data as CSV or Excel
Export tables and Bases views as paginated PDF
Copy exported PNGs to the clipboard
Configure export folder, style, and per-run options
extras: PDF exports are image-based, so text is not selectable; Bases Map export is blocked, and very tall Bases views may hit browser canvas height limits with a truncation marker applied.
problem: Getting a rendered table or Bases view out of Obsidian into a shareable image, spreadsheet, or PDF still requires manual screenshot stitching or awkward print flows.

relations.evidence: renders its tiles through MapLibre WebGL, which the current capture pipeline cannot reproduce reliably

summary: Exports rendered Markdown tables and Bases views from Obsidian to PNG, CSV, Excel, and PDF files.
